title: Lexilotl: Crossword Puzzle Run
description:
Lexilotl is a crossword puzzle run with letter and word guessing. A cozy intellectual word game. 

 

Each crossword puzzle run is about careful letter guessing, solving puzzles and a just one more puzzle relaxing flow. 

 

How to play Lexilotl: 

Guess one letter at a time, correct matches reveal all matching letter tiles. The given clue and matched letters will help keep your next guesses on track. Reveal all the words to move to the next puzzle and keep your run going. Three missed letters will end your run, the Lexilotls will help keep track of your misses. Finish the puzzle with at least one chance left and you move on to the next puzzle. Being a great speller is not required and you're not racing the clock, it's you vs. your previous best run. 

 

Feature highlights: 

• Crossword run: play a series of mini crosswords in a single run 

• Each puzzle you finish will refresh your three available tries/misses 

• The longer your run, the higher your score and run length and the more interesting words you'll encounter 

• Interconnected words and letters - one letter guess can reveal several tiles at once 

• Every guess matters, careful choices feel great as you reveal the puzzle 

• Puzzles are made of words related to the word clue 

• Designed for a satisfying just one more puzzle flow 

• Relaxing audio and focused interface keep you in the cozy puzzle of the moment 

• Built on a rich word database, using the same underlying word database that powers the typing word-action game Word Turtle Island, tuned for interesting patterns and re-playable lists 

 

 

You'll enjoy Lexilotl if: 

• you enjoy word games, crosswords, and vocabulary challenges 

• you prefer cozy, low-pressure single-player games 

• you like it when every small decision adds up to a solution 

• you want word puzzles that encourage mastery without being too stressful
